# Operation History Step 2: group_by = [], aggregations = [sum(Source5_81_4.Sales)]

target5_81.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_81_4 with Source5_81_1 on Ord_id
df = source4.merge(source1, how='inner', on='Ord_id')

# Join the result with Source5_81_3 on Ship_id
df = df.merge(source3, how='inner', on='Ship_id')

# Join the result with Source5_81_2 on Cust_id
df = df.merge(source2, how='inner', on='Cust_id')

# Join the result with Source5_81_0 on Prod_id
df = df.merge(source0, how='inner', on='Prod_id')

# Aggregate sum of Sales (no group by since target has only Sales column and no keys)
result = pd.DataFrame()
result['Sales'] = [df['Sales'].sum()]

# Write output to the target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_81/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
